component.name: Assistant
component.summary: Local AI assistant on your NPU

description.p: Assistant chats with a model running on your AMD Ryzen AI NPU through FastFlowLM. Nothing leaves your computer.

It can search the web, open apps, files and websites, change settings such as dark mode, power mode, Night Light, volume, brightness, Wi-Fi and Bluetooth, and read battery and system information. Changes that could disconnect you, and general desktop settings, ask first.
Type a question in the GNOME overview search and pick “Ask:” to get an answer as a notification.

ul.li: Can take a screenshot and keep it, so it can send it to your phone
Sends files to your own devices without asking first
Replies no longer show the model's reasoning, just "Thinking…" while it works
Restart Assistant in the menu (and on error banners) starts everything over: the service, the model server and connected apps
Review from a notification opens the new chat instead of failing with "Couldn't open that chat"

Connects the dots: works out what you mean from the chat, what it remembers and what's on the computer, and when something isn't found it gets the close matches (files, apps, devices, settings) and tries again instead of giving up
Finds a file even when the model retypes its name slightly wrong
Finds your devices by everyday name ("iPhone (Jakub)" finds jakubs-iphone), and tries again with what it knows when a tool can't find something
Sends only the tools a message needs, leaving the small model a third of the context it used to spend on them
Searches inside your apps like the overview does: sums, emoji, weather, contacts and more
Opens a terminal in a folder, using the freedesktop terminal intent when available
The window is now Rust too: no Python at all, and a faster start
Shows a file in Files with it selected, using the freedesktop file manager intent
Replies no longer show an avatar
Fixed a first question failing right after the service started
GNOME search is answered by the background service: no window process starts unless you open one
Opening a chat that is still being answered shows the rest of the answer and any question waiting for you
Window text, file contents, calendar and contacts no longer need Python
Fixed taking screenshots
The assistant now runs as a small background service written in Rust; the window is a client
The model stays loaded in the service, so the window can close without losing it
Asking from GNOME search no longer leaves a window process running
Reads the focused window and selected text, so “summarize this” works
Searches inside your files with GNOME's file index and reads PDFs and documents
Knows your calendar events and contacts from your GNOME accounts
Runs apps' actions and controls music and video players
Long chats are summarized instead of cut off
The default model stays loaded; bigger models are dropped a minute after use
Now simply called Assistant
Questions from GNOME search are answered in a notification, without opening the window
A question from search after 30 quiet minutes starts a new chat
Search also finds your skills and earlier chats
Right-click the app icon for New Chat, Look at My Screen and Unload Model
Asks first only for commands, sending files and other apps' actions, with Always Allow
Swipe back to the chat list on narrow windows; pinch or Ctrl+scroll to zoom text
Remembers facts and preferences you tell it, across chats
Skills: save a workflow once and run it again with /name
Chat history in a sidebar, with search
Looks at your screen and at images you attach, paste or drop
Runs commands in your zed toolbox, always after you allow them
Connects to saved Wi-Fi networks, VPNs and paired Bluetooth devices
Uses tools from other apps and services over MCP
Works with your files: list folders, find files by name, read text files
Understands paths relative to your home folder and folder names in any language
Sends files to your other devices with Taildrop (asks first)
Hidden files such as SSH keys stay off-limits

description.p: Understands kinds of apps: "open my email", "files" or "the browser" open your default apps, and Panda knows which apps those are.
A fresher look: a start page with a greeting and suggestions, message bubbles, Panda's avatar, compact pills for actions, a live status of what Panda is doing, and a floating message bar.

ul.li: Searches the web (DuckDuckGo, with Wikipedia as a fallback) and reads web pages
Knows this computer: model, CPU, memory, NPU, OS
Changes more settings: power mode, Night Light, and any GNOME desktop setting (asks first)
Opens the right page of GNOME Settings
Hard requests can be handed to a bigger local model (Preferences → Smarter Model)
Fixed: FastFlowLM 1.0.9 was never detected as started
Startup errors show the end of FastFlowLM's log
The model loads when you start typing and unloads after 5 minutes idle
Unload Model in the main menu frees memory right away
Context length defaults to 8K tokens instead of the model's maximum
Preferences for context length and the idle timer
